summary: 九岁入继，政由王莽；莽女为后、莽加九锡，平帝崩年十四，本纪书崩而莽传载鸠说。
summary_en: Brought in at nine with all policy from Wang Mang; Mang's daughter became empress and Mang took the Nine Distinctions. Ping died at fourteen; the benji records death, Mang's biography speaks of poison.

portrait.appearance_basis: 《汉书》未系统描写平帝形貌。画像宜表现稚龄天子的清弱之态，衣冠从西汉末制度。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 生于中山
timeline.summary_en: A son of Liu Xing, the filial king of Zhongshan.

timeline.title: 即皇帝位
timeline.summary: 哀帝崩，太皇太后与王莽定策迎中山王，年九岁即位，委政于莽。
timeline.summary_en: Emperor Ai died; the grand empress dowager and Wang Mang brought in the king of Zhongshan, nine years old, and entrusted the government to Mang.

timeline.title: 废成帝赵后哀帝傅后
timeline.title_en: The Two Empresses Dowager Set Aside
timeline.summary: 莽奏赵氏害皇子、傅氏骄僭，废二后，皆令自杀。
timeline.summary_en: Mang charged Zhao with harming princes and Fu with arrogance; both empresses dowager were deposed and ordered to kill themselves.

timeline.title: 莽为安汉公
timeline.title_en: Mang Made Duke of Anding Han
timeline.summary: 孔光等奏莽为太傅，号安汉公，盖霍光故事。
timeline.summary_en: Kong Guang and others raised Mang to Grand Tutor with the title "Duke Who Settles Han," after the precedent of Huo Guang.

timeline.title: 纳莽女为皇后
timeline.summary: 莽欲依霍光以女配帝，明年立为皇后。
timeline.summary_en: Following Huo Guang's precedent, Mang married his daughter to the emperor; she was made empress the next year.

timeline.title: 郡国大旱蝗
timeline.summary: 旱蝗，莽捐钱献田振贫，以收民誉。
timeline.summary_en: Drought and locusts struck; Mang gave money and fields to relieve the poor, winning popular acclaim.

timeline.title: 立官稷及学官
timeline.summary: 莽奏为学者筑舍万区，郡国乡聚置学官。
timeline.summary_en: Mang memorialized to build ten thousand quarters for scholars and establish schools throughout the commanderies.

timeline.title: 加莽宰衡
timeline.title_en: Mang Made Chief of the Realm
timeline.summary_en: Mang took the title "Chief of the Realm," above the Three Dukes.

timeline.title: 莽加九锡
timeline.summary: 群臣奏请九锡，莽受之，篡汉仪式完备。
timeline.summary_en: The ministers petitioned the Nine Distinctions for Mang, who accepted them — the usurpation's ceremonial machinery complete.

timeline.title: 平帝崩
timeline.summary: 帝崩，年十四；本纪书崩，《王莽传》载置毒酒之说。
timeline.summary_en: He died at fourteen; the benji records a plain death, while the Wang Mang biography records a tale of poisoned wine.

timeline.title: 立孺子居摄
timeline.summary: 立宣帝玄孙婴为皇太子，号孺子；莽居摄践祚。
timeline.summary_en: Emperor Xuan's great-great-grandson Ying was made heir, styled "the Infant," and Mang assumed the regency in his place.

relations.note: 哀帝无子，中山王箕子入继
relations.note_en: Emperor Ai had no son; Jizi, Prince of Zhongshan, succeeded from a cadet branch

relations.note: 平帝崩，孺子婴立，王莽居摄
relations.note_en: Emperor Ping dies; Ruzi Ying is installed, with Wang Mang as acting regent

relations.note: 平帝朝政皆出王莽，禅代之路完成于其身后
relations.note_en: Under Emperor Ping all governance came from Wang Mang; the abdication-usurpation path was completed after his death

bio_md:
# 汉平帝 · 主要事迹

刘衎是中山孝王刘兴之子，生于中山。元寿二年[[han-ai-di|哀帝]]崩而无嗣，太皇太后王政君与[[xin-wang-mang|王莽]]定策，迎九岁的刘衎入长安即位，是为平帝。他即位的那一天起，「政由莽出」就写在了西汉最后一份年号的每一个字里。

元始年间看似文治斐然，实则全部是王莽的表演：元年废成帝赵皇后、哀帝傅皇后，莽为安汉公；二年莽女配帝，立为皇后；三年为学者筑舍万区，立官稷、学官，郡国乡聚皆置学官；四年加宰衡，上公之位；同年群臣奏请九锡，莽受之——安汉公、宰衡、九锡，篡汉的仪式一步步走完，每走一步，平帝的本纪就多一行干巴巴的系年。

元始五年十二月，平帝崩，年十四。本纪只书「崩」字；《王莽传》则载莽以毒酒进帝之说——两说并存，史不能决。帝崩后，莽立宣帝玄孙刘婴为皇太子，号孺子，居摄践祚，两年后即取汉而代之。平帝本纪虽存，军国大事无出其手，他是西汉帝系上最彻底的傀儡：九岁入继，十四岁暴崩，中间五年，全是别人替他写好的剧本。

> 参考：点校本《汉书》卷012《平帝纪》、卷099《王莽传》，谭图第 2 册。

bio_parts_en.value: Liu Kan was the son of Liu Xing, the filial king of Zhongshan, born in Zhongshan. When
died without issue in the second Yuanshou year, the grand empress dowager Wang Zhengjun and

settled on him, and the nine-year-old king of Zhongshan was brought to Chang'an as Emperor Ping. From his first day "all policy came from Mang," written into every character of the last era name of Western Han.

The Yuanshi years looked like an age of flourishing culture, but every flourish was Wang Mang's theater: in the first year, the Zhao empress dowager of Cheng and the Fu empress dowager of Ai were deposed, and Mang took the title "Duke Who Settles Han"; in the second, Mang's daughter married the emperor and was made empress; in the third, ten thousand quarters were built for scholars, with state altars and schools established through every commandery and district; in the fourth Mang took the title "Chief of the Realm," above the Three Dukes, and the ministers petitioned the Nine Distinctions, which he accepted — Duke Who Settles Han, Chief of the Realm, Nine Distinctions: the ceremonial steps of usurpation completed one by one, each step adding one dry line of dating to Ping's annals.

In the twelfth month of the fifth Yuanshi year Ping died at fourteen. The benji records only the word "died"; the Wang Mang biography carries the tale of poisoned wine. The two versions stand together, and history cannot decide. After his death Mang raised Xuan's great-great-grandson Ying as heir, styled "the Infant," took the regency, and two years later took the dynasty itself. Ping's annals survive, but no matter of state passed through his hands: he was the most complete puppet on the Western Han throne — brought in at nine, dead at fourteen, the five years between being a script written entirely by others.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Hanshu*, ch. 12 (Benji of Emperor Ping) and ch. 99 (Biography of Wang Mang); Tan Qixiang's atlas, vol. 2.
